Those look fantastic! And I hope this is OK—since I didn’t see a recipe with the original post, I thought I would share the recipe I have been using, hopefully someone else may find it useful (it’s a “no knead” recipe, so pretty easy and not labor intensive!)

Hot Cross Buns

Combine: 1/2 cup of milk 1/4 cup oil, melted butter or shortening 2 tblsp sugar 1.5 tsp salt

Add 1/2 cup water 1 packet dry yeast: mix well

Blend in: 1 egg 1/2 cup raisins 1/2 tsp cinnamon 1 tblsp grated orange zest

Add gradually 3 cups all purpose flour; mix thoroughly until well blended and shape into a ball Cover and let sit for 30 minutes. Separate dough into 18 small buns or 12 large ones. Place on greased baking sheet. Let rise in warm place until doubled in size, about 1 hour. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F.

Mix together 1 egg white 2 tblsp cold water. Brush tops of buns with this mixture.

Snip Cut a cross into the top of each bun with scissors.

Bake For about 20 minutes (a few minutes less or more, depending on size of buns). While baking,

Combine 1/4 cup milk 1/4 tsp vanilla 3/4 cup powdered sugar. Drip the glaze over the buns while they are still hot, after removing from oven; making sure to fill each “cross” with the glaze.
